facts.text: Andrew and Audrey volunteered with animals, which they described as one of the most rewarding experiences.

evidence.quote: That's why we went volunteering with animals. It has been one of the most rewarding things I've ever done.
Yeah we had a blast volunteering. It's our way of giving back and making their lives better!

facts.text: Audrey and Andrew both expressed that pets provide unconditional love and emotional support.

evidence.quote: They always know how to listen and provide comfort when we need it. They can make us feel so loved and understood, leaving a lasting mark on our lives.
Pets truly make our lives so much better. They listen without judging and give us the best unconditional love.

facts.text: Audrey shared a memory of her childhood with her dog Max, who was a great listener and companion.

evidence.quote: Max and I would take long walks in the neighborhood when I was a kid. We explored new paths, him sniffing and marking his territory. We grew really close, and I shared my worries and hopes with him. He was a great listener, always there for me.

facts.text: Audrey and Andrew both acknowledged the positive impact of their volunteer work at the pet shelter.

evidence.quote: I'm sure the pet shelter really appreciated your help too!
It's our way of giving back and making their lives better!
